channel.title: Local News Wire Broadcast Feed
channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: The Alburg Springs border crossing in Grand Isle County will close for over a year starting later this month. Travelers to Canada must find alternate routes. The closure affects local cross-border traffic.

Jacob Cunningham, connected to Brattleboro, was charged for threatening to shoot elementary students. Police quickly stationed officers at all local schools. Cunningham was arrested in New York after the investigation.

Fair Haven has hired Kathleen Ramsey as the new town manager starting November thirtieth. She brings extensive municipal experience from Middlebury and Killington. The town also appointed Walter Panoushek as a new selectman.

Rutland has secured a site for a new skatepark near Pierpoint Avenue. The project aims to replace the park lost during the COVID-nineteen pandemic. Organizers are now seeking grants and community funding to build the park, which could cost up to one million dollars.
